results.notes: This document reported on the activities of the Alberta Health Disciplines Board for the year 1984, following amendments that changed the Health Occupations Act to the Health Disciplines Act. The Board investigated 16 health disciplines, assessed risks to the public, and recommended the designation or non-designation of disciplines such as emergency medical technician, medical radiation technologist, respiratory technologist, nursing assistant, and acupuncture. The Board established committees for regulated disciplines, drafted regulations in consultation with stakeholders, and facilitated public input through written briefs and oral presentations. New designations included hearing aid practitioner and combined laboratory and x-ray technology, while ongoing investigations covered therapeutic massage, medical geneticists, homeopathy, and naturopathy. The report summarised regulatory procedures, committee activities, and legislative changes affecting health disciplines in Alberta.
